metadata.title: हेमंत की बातें आदिवासियों के दिल में उतर गई | Adivasis of Birsa Munda's village support Hemant Soren
metadata.description: In his speech in the Jharkhand Vidhan Sabha, Hemant Soren accused the state’s governor of involvement in his arrest and criticized the BJP for mistreating Adivasi and Dalit communities. He emphasized the need to break societal perceptions and uplift these communities. The reaction of the people of Jharkhand, particularly from Ulihatu, the birthplace of Birsa Munda, is featured in a report. The report explores whether the people of Jharkhand trust Hemant Soren's statements and examines their potential impact on his party's fortunes in upcoming elections.
